meta.title: About DevInvicta
meta.description: Learn about DevInvicta, an AI-first software engineering company building custom, scalable software with technical excellence and EU AI Act compliance.

partners.statement: We engineer software that scales, performs and ships, turning complex technical challenges into intelligent systems that accelerate your business from day one.

stats.intro: Founded in 2024, DevInvicta was born from the vision of its founder, José Neves, after years of experience in the software development sector. Our mission is to deliver tailored software that generates real value, grows with clients and is ready for the future of Artificial Intelligence.
stats.years: Years of activity, turning years of software development experience into custom solutions that grow with our clients.
stats.ai: Solutions focus, building production-ready intelligence that is compliant with European regulation from day one.
stats.endToEnd: Complete software, delivered end-to-end from architecture and deployment through maintenance and continuous evolution.

mission.headline: We build intelligent software that scales and generates real value.
mission.body: We pair technological innovation with technical rigor and a relentless focus on client results, delivering software that grows with your business. Our vision is to be the European reference in AI software development, recognised for technical excellence, regulatory compliance and the ability to transform businesses.

values.headline: The values that shape everything we build.

responsibleAi.title: Responsible AI innovation
responsibleAi.body: We bring intelligence into every layer of the system responsibly, building production-ready AI that is safe, accountable and built to last.

clientFocus.title: Client focus
clientFocus.body: We stay close and fully transparent until every detail is right, aligned with your goals at every stage so the result drives real business value.

compliance.title: Regulatory compliance
compliance.body: Full focus on the EU AI Act and European regulation, giving you legal safety from day one across every project we deliver.

excellence.title: Technical excellence
excellence.body: A highly specialised team holds quality and rigour intact from the first line of code to the final delivery, with no shortcuts.

milestones.headline: Recognition & milestones driving impact and innovation

approach.headline: Why companies choose DevInvicta
approach.body: From deep technical know-how to full regulatory compliance, we combine the experience, rigour and global perspective needed to turn ambitious ideas into software that lasts.

diagnostic.title: Free diagnostic
diagnostic.body: An initial, no-commitment session to analyse your business and propose concrete solutions before you decide anything.

aiWorks.title: AI that actually works
aiWorks.body: We build production-ready AI and machine learning systems that run reliably, compound over time and deliver measurable outcomes.

complete.title: Complete software
complete.body: End-to-end delivery from architecture to deployment, including maintenance and continuous evolution as your business grows.
